text: Select the table A1:P500 (with its heading) and apply Format as Table using "Table Style Medium 3".
Fill the Zone table's heading R1:W1 with Theme Colour "Blue, Accent 1", white font colour, Bold and Center.
In column J (Total) find the Total of Written, Interview and GK marks (F to H) for every candidate using the SUM function.
In column K (Percentage) find the percentage of every candidate. The maximum Total is 80, rounded to 2 decimal places with ROUND.
In column L (Grade) using the IFS function give grade on Percentage: 80 or more = "A+", 65 or more = "A", 50 or more = "B", 35 or more = "C", otherwise "D".
In column M (Result) using IF write "Qualified" if the Total is 40 or more (>=40), otherwise "Not Qualified".
In column N (Selection) using IF with AND write "Selected" if the Result is "Qualified" AND the Typing Speed is 30 WPM or more, otherwise "Not Selected".
In column O (Fee Waiver) using IF with OR write "Yes" if the Category is "SC" OR "ST", otherwise "No".
In column P (Zone) using HLOOKUP find each candidate's Zone from the table R1:W2 (district names in row 1, zone in row 2), based on the District.
In cell Y2 count the total number of candidates using COUNTA on Candidate Name.
In cell Y3 find the Median Total using the MEDIAN function.
In cell Y4 find the Admission Index -- the sum of (Written marks x Typing Speed) for every candidate -- using the SUMPRODUCT function.
Using COUNTIFS, in cell Y5 count the girl candidates (Gender = "F") whose Result is "Qualified".
In cell Y6 find the average Written marks of the SC category candidates using AVERAGEIFS, rounded to 2 decimal places with ROUND.
Freeze the top row of the sheet so the headings stay visible while scrolling, and apply Filter to the table A1:P500.
